show.description: “Eternal Yogi” follows Gautam, an immortal yogi,  reunites with his lost love "Sunaina" , after 1200 years. Who Now reincarnated as Dr. Janvi Kapoor. Amid divine forces and demonic threats, he battles Kaalroop to protect both love and humanity. The saga ends with evil’s destruction and the lovers’ eternal union beyond time. Watch now.
